fields.name: Cornell University
fields.description: Cornell's Office of Global Learning manages incoming international exchange students from partner universities worldwide. The portal covers the full student lifecycle from eligibility through arrival.

fields.name: Florida International University
fields.description: FIU's Education Abroad portal manages the International Student Exchange program with a step-by-step application workflow and a course equivalency database.

fields.name: University College London
fields.description: UCL is a world top-10 university in London, offering exchange students access to a wide range of faculties and research centers.

fields.name: National University of Singapore
fields.description: NUS is Asia's leading global university, ranked consistently in the top 15 worldwide. Strong programs in engineering, business, and computing.

fields.name: Sciences Po Paris
fields.description: Sciences Po is one of Europe's most prestigious social sciences institutions, known for international relations, law, economics, and political science.

fields.name: Tecnológico de Monterrey
fields.language_requirement: Spanish B2 or English TOEFL iBT 79
fields.description: Tec de Monterrey is Mexico's leading private university with 26 campuses. Strong in business, engineering, and technology innovation.

fields.name: University of Melbourne
fields.description: Australia's #1 university with a vibrant multicultural campus, offering exchanges across all faculties including arts, science, and business.

fields.name: Maastricht University
fields.description: Known for its Problem-Based Learning approach, Maastricht University is highly international with over 50% international students and strong programs in law and business.
